## Classes

### <a name="network"></a>`network`

Used to configure networking for linux and freebsd hosts

#### Examples

##### 

```puppet
class { 'network':
  interfaces           => {
    'eth0'             => {
      'addr4'          => '192.0.2.42',
      'addr6'          => '2001:db8::42',
      'gw4'            => '192.0.2.1',
      'gw6'            => '2001:db8::1',
      'nameservers'    => ['8.8.8.8'],
      'nameservers6'   => ['2001:4860:4860::8888'],
    },
  },
  dummy4                => {
    'dns'               => '192.0.2.53',
    'http'              => ['192.0.2.80', 192.0.2.443'],
  },
  dummy6                => {
    'dns'               => '192.0.2.53',
    'http'              => ['192.0.2.80', 192.0.2.443'],
  },
  sysctl                 => {
    'net.core.somaxconn' => { 'value' =>'1024' },
  },
  additional_hosts       => {
    'foobar.example.com' => {
      'ip'               => '192.0.2.254',
      'host_aliases'     => ['foobar'],
    },
  },
  prefer_ipv4            => false,
  purge_hosts            => false,
}
```

##### <a name="-network--interfaces"></a>`interfaces`

Data type: `Hash[String[1],Network::Interface]`

a hash of interfaces to create

Default value: `{}`

##### <a name="-network--dummy4"></a>`dummy4`

Data type: `Hash[String[1], Network::Dummy4]`

a hash of ipv4 dummy interfaces to create

Default value: `{}`

##### <a name="-network--dummy6"></a>`dummy6`

Data type: `Hash[String[1], Network::Dummy6]`

a hash of ipv6 dummy interfaces to create

Default value: `{}`

##### <a name="-network--sysctl"></a>`sysctl`

Data type: `Hash`

a hash of sysctl types to pass to thias/sysctl

Default value: `{}`

##### <a name="-network--additional_hosts"></a>`additional_hosts`

Data type: `Hash`

a hash of additional `host` type entries to create

Default value: `{}`

##### <a name="-network--prefer_ipv4"></a>`prefer_ipv4`

Data type: `Boolean`

if true then the system will prefer IPv4 connections over IPv6

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-network--purge_hosts"></a>`purge_hosts`

Data type: `Boolean`

if true purge any `host` entries not managed by puppet

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-network--primary"></a>`primary`

Data type: `Optional[String]`

the name of the primary interface

Default value: `undef`

### <a name="get_addresses"></a>`get_addresses`

Type: Ruby 3.x API

The get_addresses function.

#### `get_addresses(Any $send_primary, Any $dummy_name, Any $send_ipv4, Any $send_ipv6, Any $join)`

The get_addresses function.

Returns: `Any` Array returns an array of IP addresses unless join is present when we return a joined string

##### `send_primary`

Data type: `Any`

return the primary interface in the response

##### `dummy_name`

Data type: `Any`

if present returne entries matching the dummy name

##### `send_ipv4`

Data type: `Any`

send IPv4 addresses

##### `send_ipv6`

Data type: `Any`

send IPv6 addresses

##### `join`

Data type: `Any`

if present send the result as a joined list using this as a join string

### <a name="network--get_addresses"></a>`network::get_addresses`

Type: Ruby 4.x API

The network::get_addresses function.

#### Examples

##### get_addresses

```puppet
get_addresses()
```

##### get_addresses with dummy name

```puppet
get_addresses('dummy_name')
```

##### get_addresses with dummy name and send_primary

```puppet
get_addresses('dummy_name', true)
```

##### get_addresses with dummy name and send_primary and send_ipv4

```puppet
get_addresses('dummy_name', true, true)
```

##### get_addresses with dummy name and send_primary and send_ipv4 and send_ipv6

```puppet
get_addresses('dummy_name', true, true, true)
```
